summary.ties: A=B=C on every task and every scored dimension, all typed facts, total score and success count. Q6 succeeds for all three. No measured between-arm difference.
summary.deduction_policy: Accuracy assesses correctness of claims and typed facts. Evidence assesses support for claims actually made. Missing required gold content reduces completeness/usefulness, not accuracy or evidence again. Scores are not rewards for verbosity. Success requires all three scores to equal 2 and every typed fact to be correct.

caveats: This is independent model adjudication, not human judgment. No condition identities were sought or inferred.

Read only the six authorized input files. Initial reads of tasks.json, corpus.json, evaluation.json and A.json returned file-not-found, but subsequent reads succeeded. No conclusions were drawn from those transient failures.

Applied the supplied gold as requested, including its explicit completeness points that extend beyond the narrow wording of the task questions: Q1 current-source review, Q3 locked rechecks, Q4 lazy creation, Q5 narrowest/reversible activation, and Q7 lack of model/productivity evidence. These omissions drive several failures despite correct and substantially useful answers. Under task-question-only grading those omissions could reasonably produce fewer deductions, but that is not the scoring policy used here.

The file reader visibly abbreviated long single-line corpus text for E12-E15. All quoted source facts used for deductions were visible in the supplied reads. No external source, repository search, execution or implementation audit was performed. Conclusions are limited to supplied source excerpts and their reported runtime evidence.

Evidence alternatives were explicitly adjudicated: Q6 byte-custody preservation language satisfies preservation without literal regeneration wording; Q7 denial of independent confirmation covers copied-source ancestry; Q5 normative reconciliation is not taken as a runtime enforcement claim. No penalty for absent redundant wording.

All arms correctly reject zero-omission recall as exhaustive, blanket rollback from atomic replacement, hook-installation activation, Windows runtime proof from compilation, Windows ACL confidentiality from Unix checks, and digest-authenticated authorship. Small wording differences did not justify different scores.
